name: walk_hands_pockets
text: A man strolls forward at a steady pace with his left hand in his left trouser side pocket and his right hand in his right trouser side pocket. His wrists stay far apart on the outer left and right sides of his hips. Both elbows bend behind his sides. His arms stay still while his legs alternate in ordinary walking steps. He never brings his hands together.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 双手稳定收在前裤袋位置，肘部外张；保持前进和交替步态。第二试片替换了双手交叉的首版，循环取中间完整周期。未生成裤袋实体，服装接触由接入端确认。
